# SOP-P1-L3-03 First-article inspection - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03  
Related: ECN-2026-035, QS-PROC-04, SB-1026

1. Purpose
   - Confirm first-article parts produced on P1-L3 meet drawing and process requirements prior to batch release.

2. Preconditions
   - Production run setup complete on EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and EQ-P1-L3-CN03, and material conditioned on EQ-P1-L3-IH01.
   - Verify change incorporation per ECN-2026-035 before inspection.
   - Ensure QS-PROC-04 traceability requirements are in place.

3. PPE
   - Wear required plant PPE per SB-1026.

4. Machine verification
   - Confirm EQ-P1-L3-HP02 main ram bolt is tightened to the specification: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 1330 N·m.
   - Confirm cooling flow to EQ-P1-L3-IH01: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 79 L/min.
   - Record verification results on first-article checklist.

5. Dimensional inspection
   - Perform full dimensional inspection against drawing notes and record results on first-article checklist.
   - Capture critical characteristic disposition per QS-PROC-04.

6. Functional checks
   - Run functional checks on EQ-P1-L3-CN03 as applicable and document findings.

7. Nonconformance handling
   - If any characteristic fails, document per QS-PROC-04 and initiate containment per ECN-2026-035.

8. Documentation and disposition
   - Attach completed first-article checklist and inspection data to the lot files.
   - Reference SB-1026 for documentation retention and access.

9. Sign-off
   - Inspector printed name, signature, and date.
   - Engineering review printed name, signature, and date.
   - Production supervisor printed name, signature, and date.

References: ECN-2026-035; QS-PROC-04; SB-1026.
